decision: Select hybrid final implementation for this feature, authorized by user after quality comparison.

incremental.acceptance_scope: Historical prior-arm acceptance; not re-reviewed against new hybrid-specific probes.

end_only.acceptance_scope: Historical prior-arm acceptance; not re-reviewed against new hybrid-specific probes.

hybrid.acceptance_scope: Incremental acceptance then fresh final review, known-case crosscheck and all resulting remediation.

marginal_final_stage.meaning: Actual added stage costs for fresh review, any repair, crosschecks and closure. No counterfactual saved-work estimate.

outcomes.overlap: Frozen nonobject case overlaps HFCR-001 and is not counted again.

interpretation: Fresh final review added three separately reported findings after incremental acceptance; this establishes added detection on this candidate, not highest achievable quality.
Frozen external counterexamples still found two additional gaps after fresh final review; neither review arrangement proved complete recall.
Hybrid used more recorded builder/reviewer input than either earlier arm after repairs; this run did not show a token-cost win.

The additional final stage includes reviewer work, failed startup, builder repairs driven by both fresh findings and external crosschecks; cannot assign all of its repair cost uniquely to fresh review.
Do not infer a general review policy winner from one stochastic run per route or compare test counts as quality scores.
limits: Earlier two endpoints retained unchanged and not re-scored on all newly discovered hybrid-specific cases; no equal residual-defect-rate or highest-quality ranking established.
Root knew prior outcomes; controls frozen before hybrid launch only, not a preregistered three-arm experiment.
Original first arm shared dirty workspace; later arms isolated. Root context histories differ.

Failed blind-entry attempt exposed prior findings through mandatory board read; stopped before substantive review, cost included. Replacement used clean clone with no prior board refs, separate episode, same model. No capability-enforced independence claim.
Usage-limit interruption and overnight idle gap make raw elapsed unsuitable as active-work latency; no provider/account settings changed.
Input includes cached tokens; output includes reasoning subset. No dollar/quota estimate.
Root snapshot excludes its final measurement/report response calls; all completed child terminal counters are included.

quality.conclusion: Hybrid has strongest observed final-artifact quality on these common known cases; both earlier final endpoints retain the same three demonstrated defect families. No general causal superiority of the review route established.

method.build: Offline locked rebuild from each clean frozen endpoint; binary copies hashed; Git archives SHA256-bound; endpoints verified clean again after execution.
method.oracle: Coordinator-authored executable contract-level checks, schema-aware. Three expectation interpretation amendments disclosed in adjudication. No fresh model reviewer launched.

No secret body sentinel exported in any of102observations. All refuse tested total overflow and session mismatch without ledger. This is not an exhaustive privacy or bounds audit.

End-only and hybrid sum individually known counters; incremental retains them in rows but uses its documented eligible subset for aggregate sums. Hybrid can retain numeric complete_* row-subset sums despite top-level incomplete for skipped records or late fork ambiguity; consumers must honor top-level status. No new defect inferred solely from cross-schema field differences.

limits: Known-case selection includes probes used to repair hybrid; this demonstrates repair coverage, not unseen-case generalization.
One task and one implementation per route; reviewer effort, total budget and later knowledge differ. Cannot isolate effect of review timing or establish statistical superiority.
No claim of zero remaining bugs; maintainability, architecture, performance and production prevalence not compared.
No fresh paid reviews or remediation cycles launched. Historical acceptance and cost artifacts remain unchanged; findings are retrospective residual behavior.
No aggregate pass percentage: correlated variants, explicit refusals and hardening differences are distinct outcomes.
quality.next_inference: Evidence favors the hybrid endpoint for this feature and supports the value of a fresh final review after incremental review. Testing the route requires unseen cases, matched effort and repeated tasks.
